title: Spirography
description: Interactive visualization of spirography patterns created by rolling circles, exploring hypotrochoid and epitrochoid curves.
author: Ugur Kostak
content: An interactive exploration of spirography patterns, where rolling circles create mathematical art. Adjust outer radius, inner radius, and pen distance to generate infinite variations of beautiful parametric curves.

title: Manhattan Distance Visualization
description: Interactive demo of the Manhattan (L1) distance metric: drag points, see axis-aligned paths and diamond neighborhoods.
author: Ugur Kostak
content: An interactive visualization of the Manhattan (L1) distance metric. Drag points to see how the sum of absolute differences defines geometry, shortest paths, and neighborhoods in 2D.

title: AlexNet Visualization
description: Interactive 3D view of AlexNet's fully connected classifier head: sampled neurons, biases, and weighted connections you can rotate, zoom, and hover.
author: Ugur Kostak
content: A 3D, mouse-driven look at the three Linear layers of the official torchvision AlexNet (IMAGENET1K_V1). Four columns of sampled neurons are linked by colored weight lines, with biases on the spheres and exact weights on hover.

title: Curve Onion
description: Plot y = x^n and y = x^(1/n) for n = 1 to 100 on the unit square and an onion emerges: power curves layering from the diagonal outward like concentric skins.
author: Ugur Kostak
content: Curve Onion plots the full family of power functions y = x^n and their inverses y = x^(1/n) on the unit square. As n grows from 1 to 100, each curve bows further from the diagonal and closer to the axes, filling the square with symmetric, onion-like layers. Hover any curve to read its exponent and role. Adjust N to add or remove layers, switch between the two families, or show both together.

title: Nested Polygon Layers
description: A geometric parametric design composed of nested polygons that gradually decrease in size and rotate into layered petals.
author: Ugur Kostak
content: Nested Polygon Layers is a beautiful geometric shape composed of nested polygons that gradually decrease in size. Sides, layer depth, twist, and shrink define the shells, while straight connections between matching vertices create the illusion of curved petals.

title: 3D Cube Visualization
description: A compact WebGL geometry study that uses an interactive cube to make rotation, projection, and surface direction easier to read.
author: Ugur Kostak
content: A browser-based 3D cube experiment that makes simple geometry feel tangible. The cube can be rotated directly, while the surface colors reveal how its faces point through space. It is a small visual test bed for projection, interaction, and the way a renderer turns mathematical shape into something readable.

title: The Beauty of Prime Numbers
description: A visual walk through the Ulam Spiral, where prime numbers form surprising diagonal patterns inside a simple grid of natural numbers.
author: Ugur Kostak
content: An exploration of the Ulam Spiral, where natural numbers are arranged in a square spiral and prime numbers are highlighted. The result turns an apparently irregular sequence into visible diagonal patterns and prime-rich structures, showing how a very simple drawing rule can expose hidden order in number theory.
